<infobox theme="Media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="title"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Publication information</header>
        <data source="game"><label>Game</label></data>
        <data source="publisher"><label>Publisher</label></data>	
        <data source="release date"><label>Publication date</label></data>   
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>
        <data source="figures"><label>No. of figures</label></data>
        <data source="cards"><label>No. of cards</label></data>
        <data source="isbn"><label>[[Wikipedia:International Standard Book Number|ISBN]]</label><format>[[Special:Booksources/{{{isbn}}}|{{{isbn}}}]]</format></data>
        <data source="upc"><label>[[Wikipedia:Universal Product Code|UPC]]</label></data>
        <data source="timeline"><label>Timeline</label></data>
        <data source="preceded by"><label>Preceded by</label></data>
        <data source="followed by"><label>Followed by</label></data>			
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:ExpansionPack|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|title|game|publisher|release date|figures|cards|isbn|upc|timeline|preceded by|followed by|ignore=name}}<!--
-->{{#invoke:MediaDateCheck|main|no_year_check={{{no_year_check|}}}|template_name=ExpansionPack}}<noinclude>[[Category:Game infoboxes]]{{clear}}

}}</pre></noinclude>
